text:
Liang W: Heads-up — saw a sharp drop in OCR->translate sentence-boundary detection after int8 bringup for tempest-v2.
Maya R: ugh, how big? repro + sample please
Liang W: Quick numbers: eval on ocr-jp-zh 1k lines
python eval_suite.py --model=tempest-v2 --quant=int8 --dataset=ocr-jp-zh --metric=sent_bound_f1,wer
Result: sent_bound_f1=0.68 (before int8: 0.95), wer +2.1 pts
Sofia P: that's huge. Any sample diffs?
Liang W: sample input (raw OCR):
"今日はいい天気ですね。明日は雨が降るかもしれません。"
Output (int8): "今日はいい天気ですね明日は雨が降るかもしれません"
 -> missing sentence break / punctuation detachment
Maya R: is the tokenizer dropping the Japanese '。' or is detok glueing sentences?
Liang W: looks like detok combined. Checking token stream vs float model.
---
Liang W: Token sequence (float): [... '。', SEP, ...]
Liang W: Token sequence (int8):  [... '。', SEP, ...]  <-- tokens preserved, but EOS-prob at boundary is much lower
Maya R: so tokens present but model doesn't output boundary -> prob shift
Sofia P: maybe softmax temp or layernorm quantization shift. Any bisect info?
Liang W: bisected to commit abc123 (quant kernel selection change: fused ln->qmerge). Repro passes on previous commit def456.
Triage Bot: Suggested triage steps: 1) compare pre/post logits for punct/EOS tokens on 100 samples 2) run with fp16 quant emulation 3) disable fused-kernel
Liang W: quick logit diff (sample):
```
Token: '。'   logit_fp32=3.8   logit_int8=1.2  (softmax prob drop 0.85->0.22)
Token: ' '    logit_fp32=0.6   logit_int8=0.5
EOS token:    logit_fp32=4.1   logit_int8=1.0
```
Maya R: wow. that suggests numerical bias from fused kernel or requant scale mismatch
Sofia P: also check kv-cache quantization path — if prefix attention scales differ, boundary probabilities can shift for shortctx OCR lines
Liang W: running targeted repro with kvcache disabled now
CI Bot: FYI — added regression test template to PR #8421 (ocr-sent-bound-int8)
Maya R: action items: Liang -> minimal repro & bisect artifact, Sofia -> test layernorm/fused-kernel toggles, me -> add CI test and run full 10k sample sweep. We'll sync tomorrow.
Sofia P: I'll try running the same samples with qscale tweak + per-channel weight rescale.
Liang W: thanks, I'll upload logs to /mnt/infra/tempest/ocr-int8-bisect/ and ping when done :eyes:
Maya R: thanks team :thumbsup:
